title: Unit Event — Farewell, My Mask — Episode1 Eroding Heart

meta.Event Outline: As if losing her computer wasn't bad enough, Mafuyu feels her mother's grip tighten on her life, taking an increasing toll on her mental state. Amid all this, her teacher is due to return the results of a final...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That's it for Modern Japanese. Which just leaves math...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should be able to solve this correctly as long as I follow this formula and don't make any calculation errors.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Lately, my concentration's been breaking over the smallest noises.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I struggled to focus even during finals the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Mom must've been checking to see how I was doing... Because she's worried about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How are your studies going, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Fine.
I should be able to get through everything that I need to do today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, it's getting late, so why don't you find a good spot to wrap things up? You need your rest.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You can always wake up early tomorrow morning to finish the rest. Also, here's some warm milk.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you'll be getting your finals back tomorrow, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing good results since you studied so hard for them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, please try to go to bed soon. Good night.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The others are probably working right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I should sleep...
But I'm still nowhere near finished.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll keep working on these for a little while longer...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
I'll be returning your finals now.
Please come up when I call your name.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing good results since you studied so hard for them.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To be honest, Asahina, you made quite a few more mistakes than usual. Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Really? Well, my door's always open...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
Do you get your finals back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, the teachers are apparently very busy and need a little more time to grade them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I understand they have tough jobs, but I hope they finish grading them soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I couldn't tell her about how I really did...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But I won't be able to hide that forever...
I should tell her sooner rather than later.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm afraid of what she's going to say when she sees that my grades are starting to slip.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Not just say... What she might do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And I have another mock exam coming up.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Doing well on that might make up for how I did on my finals...)
